description: Required zone policies for both environments and account emergency shutdown.

mediaAccess.expression: ((http.host eq "store-media.vrclearn.com" and http.request.uri.path ne "/cdn-cgi/access/authorized" and (ip.src.country in {"XX" "T1"} or (ip.src.country eq "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cn/")) or (ip.src.country ne "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/intl/")))) or (http.host eq "test-store-media.vrclearn.com" and http.request.uri.path ne "/cdn-cgi/access/authorized" and (ip.src.country in {"XX" "T1"} or (ip.src.country eq "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cn/")) or (ip.src.country ne "CN" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/intl/")))))

emergencyDynamicStop.expression: ((http.host eq "store.vrclearn.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path contains "/products/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/shops/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/sitemap.xml" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sitemaps/"))) or (http.host eq "test-store.vrclearn.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path contains "/products/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/shops/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/sitemap.xml" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sitemaps/"))))

mediaCache.expression: ((http.host eq "store-media.vrclearn.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cn/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/intl/"))) or (http.host eq "test-store-media.vrclearn.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cn/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/intl/"))))
